market.headline: Stocks fell into Nvidia's report as rates and fear rose. Tonight's Nvidia outlook decides whether the AI selloff pauses or goes deeper.
market.day_type: Broad risk-off selloff led by chips and AI spenders. A Fed official called for more rate hikes, the 10-year yield sits at 5.15% (from 4.84%), the VIX is 22.91 (from 19.92), and investors cut risk before Nvidia reported.
watch: Tonight and the open: Nvidia's outlook, not the beat. After hours Nvidia is up 2.4% and the chip group is rising with it.
SPY 729.79 (200-day average). Holding it after the first hour means the selloff is pausing. A close below it means the next leg down has started.
QQQ 646.65 (today's low and its 20-day low). Below it, tech sells off again. It is already under its 200-day average of 681.58.

stocks.headline: Down 0.4% to 155.46 ahead of its report, now -28.2% in 20 days; up 2.4% to 159.17 after hours. This morning's Hold call: right.
stocks.why: The 20-day drop comes from the CEO scandal and export fears, not from the business. Sales are up 106% and speeding up, each $100 of sales leaves $65 of operating profit, and the stock trades at 10× next year's profit, its cheapest in 5 years. Huang now says he is willing to come back. But the DOJ is investigating Megaspeed, and Nvidia stopped breaking out its Singapore sales. That keeps a governance cloud over the stock that a good quarter does not clear. The whole chip complex follows Nvidia tomorrow: TSM, MU, ARM, AMD, AVGO and CRWV are all up after hours.

long_term.reason: Agrees with the house view. The business is the strongest in the group and cheap, but leadership and the Singapore probe are still open questions. That is not yet a clean Buy.

stocks.what_would_change_it: Huang reinstated plus a strong outlook upgrades it to Buy. A probe that reaches Nvidia's own Singapore sales makes it a Trim.
stocks.action: Holders keep their shares. Don't buy the open; new money only if it holds above 158.19 after the first hour and then closes above 163.2.

levels.means: above = the post-report rally is real and the downtrend is breaking; below = it's still just a bounce
above = the after-hours gain is holding; below = the market is selling the report
above = the 52-week low holds; below = a new low, so cut back to a smaller position

stocks.headline: Fell 3.4% to 115.00, below this morning's 118.25 trigger. This morning's buy-half call: wrong (too early).
stocks.why: Oracle fell with every AI-spending name. A higher-for-longer rate outlook and talk of trouble at the neoclouds hit companies that are building data centers fast. The business still points up: sales are up 30% and speeding up, the contracted backlog is $664.0B, and the stock is at 10.3× next year's profit, cheaper than 95% of the last 5 years. The risk is what it costs to deliver that backlog. Analysts expect profit per share to fall 16% at the Dec 14 report, and a strong Nvidia outlook tonight would ease the fear around AI spending.

long_term.reason: Agrees with the house view of Buy now. The backlog and the price outweigh the spending risk, and today's drop was market-driven, not company news.

stocks.what_would_change_it: A close below 109.21, or a cut to the backlog or a rise in spending at the Dec 14 report, would move it to Wait.
stocks.action: Keep the half position. Don't add at the open even though it's up 1.6% after hours; buy the second half only on a close back above 118.25.

levels.means: above = the selloff is reversed, buy the second half; below = keep the half only
above = today's low holds; below = the drop is continuing
above = the 52-week low holds; below = a new low, stop adding until the report

stocks.headline: Fell 3.7% to 359.69 on 1.6× normal volume, -9.3% in 5 days; up 3.3% to 371.70 after hours.
stocks.why: Heavy volume shows big holders sold on fears of tighter US chip export rules and a slower AI data-center build-out. TSM makes the chips for Nvidia, AMD, Broadcom and Arm, so it moves with Nvidia's outlook. The after-hours jump shows the market reading tonight as a relief. At 15.4× next year's profit, with analysts' average target at 586.7, the price already reflects a lot of bad news.

long_term.reason: The house has no long-term view. Our call: it is the toll road for every AI chip and trades at 15.4× forward profit, so buy weakness rather than strength.

stocks.what_would_change_it: A formal new US export rule that covers TSM's advanced chips moves it to Wait.
